# A 100.00 USD invoice for C-US whose grouped payment block applies one split:
# a credit an unpost handed back.
#
# Imported after `fx_invoice_usd_overpaid_into_usd_bank.txt`, whose 100.00 USD
# credit `fx_invoice_auto_applying_the_whole_credit.txt` spent whole and
# `unpost-invoices INV-USD-AUTO` handed back. That split carries
# `applied_from_credit`, the unpost's orphan KVP, and here a cost basis balance
# stated with `--strategy update`. The test puts the transaction's guid in place
# of TXN_GUID and the split's in place of SPLIT_GUID.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-USD-GROUPED settled by that split, which
# keeps `applied_from_credit` and its cost and gives up its cost basis balance.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_grouped_payment_spending_a_handed_back_credit_takes_its_balance_off.py.
invoice "INV-USD-GROUPED"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-10
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-10
		description: "Grouped"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-10
		due: 2026-04-10
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-GROUPED"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-10
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		Transaction "TXN_GUID"
			PaymentSplit "SPLIT_GUID"
